content: librosa's chroma feature (librosa.feature.chroma_stft / chroma_cqt) computes a 12-bin pitch-class energy histogram over audio STFT/CQT. For MIDI this collapses trivially: each MIDI note has a known pitch = midi % 12, so the chroma vector is a direct integer histogram of pitches (no STFT needed). The rhythm quantization analog is librosa.onset.onset_strength + librosa.effects.hpss for front-end, but for MIDI the rhythm feature is the inter-onset-interval (IOI) histogram + step-pattern (16th/8th/quarter density). Krumhansl-Schmuckler key-finding (the standard algorithm librosa-inspired MIR borrows) correlates the PCP against 24 reference profiles (Krumhansl-Kessler major/minor templates); the correlation scores give a confidence. For MIDI-01 motif signature: combine (a) a 12-bin normalized PCP (transposition-invariant identity), (b) an IOI bucket histogram (e.g. 4-6 buckets: <0.25, 0.25-0.5, 0.5-1, 1-2, >2 beats), (c) optionally a step-density-ratio (notes/beat). Similarity = cosine over PCP (weighted ~0.6) + IOI histogram intersection (weighted ~0.4). This is a principled adaptation, not a verbatim librosa port.
